pages.name: About
pages.seoTitle: About The Meridian: a reader-funded magazine of ideas
pages.seoDescription: Who The Meridian is and how it is funded: reader-supported longform with no advertiser behind it, in print four times a year and online every week.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: The Meridian is a magazine of essays and ideas. We publish long (a piece here can run four thousand words if the argument earns them) because the writing we care about is the kind that needs room to breathe. We would rather run one essay that changes how you see a thing than ten posts that confirm what you already believed.

We are reader-funded, and that is not a detail. It means our only obligation is to you, the person reading, not to an advertiser, not to an algorithm, not to whatever the feed decided was urgent this morning. A membership pays a writer to spend three weeks on a piece, and pays us to hold it until it is finished.
We come out four times a year in print, and every week online. The archive is open. Start anywhere.
